profile.name: Philipe Felix
profile.introduction: I design and build data platforms, backend services and web applications, bringing 15+ years of experience in cloud-native architecture, ETL pipelines and technical leadership.
profile.pageTitle: Philipe Felix — Software Engineer & Data Engineer
profile.metaDescription: Explore the software and data engineering services and selected work of Philipe Felix.

services.title: Data engineering
services.description: Data pipelines and ETL on AWS and Google Cloud, from ingestion with Apache Airflow to analytics-ready datasets in BigQuery and Amazon Athena.

services.title: Backend and APIs
services.description: REST APIs and microservices in Python, Java and Node.js, built with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.

services.title: Web development
services.description: Responsive web applications built with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue.js and modern front-end tooling.

services.title: Technical leadership
services.description: Architecture decisions, code reviews and mentoring for engineering teams, including AI-powered applications using RAG and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

projects.title: Device Upgrade Intelligence Platform
projects.summary: Led a data science initiative to identify mobile device upgrades from event logs and network traffic. Built for UOL, the device identification methodology secured three consecutive years of contracts with a major consumer electronics company.

projects.title: UOL Tag Manager and PayUOL
projects.summary: Built advertising resource management, tracking and retargeting tools for UOL, along with PayUOL, a paywall solution across UOL pages with segmented testing.

projects.title: Veja São Paulo app
projects.summary: Developed a hybrid mobile app for Editora Abril that recommends establishments based on the user’s location.
